esp32_hub_target.ble_mtu_note: Default BLE ATT MTU is 20 bytes per notify packet; app MUST buffer incoming chunks until '\n' before parsing JSON!

commands_phone_to_esp2.effect: Silences ESP32 #1 speaker for 30s and logs alert_dismissed on Server
Stops Level-3 drowsy latched alarm on ESP32 #1 and starts 2-4 min relapse probation window on Pi 4
Sets monitoring mode to AUTO (default on boot; auto-detects presence & absence)
Sets monitoring mode to TEMP_PAUSE_30M (suppresses absence alert 30 min; keeps violation alerts if driver is visible)
Sets monitoring mode to REST_SLEEP_OFF (camera monitors silently for sleeping/eating; auto-resumes AUTO at >=15 km/h or Pi reboot)
Raises CRITICAL SOS_PRESSED incident on Server (0 driver Safety Score penalty!)
Starts 10s MediaPipe 478-point posture & eye baseline calibration on Pi 4 and locks driver_profile.json
Requests immediate STATUS:{...} JSON snapshot from ESP32 #2

notifications_esp2_to_phone.meaning: Real-time safety alert from Pi 4 -> ESP2 -> Phone; includes DROWSY_LEVEL3, DROWSY_RELAPSE, DRIVER_ABSENT, MODE_AUTO; NOTE: ALERT:CALIB_START|10s, ALERT:CALIB_PROGRESS|<n>s, ALERT:CALIB_DONE|locked, ALERT:CALIB_FAIL|<reason>, and ALERT:INFO|... are informational notices (MUST NOT trigger danger siren/red banner!)
Live UART2 hardware GPS pushed every 2s while BLE connected
Full ESP2 hub status JSON on STATUS command
Command accepted by ESP2 and forwarded over USB UART to Pi 4

optional_server_http_endpoints.pair_otp_issue_operator: POST /api/v1/phone/pair_otp (alias /api/v1/phone/pair/otp also supported; requires operator token; returns 5-min single-use pair_code)
optional_server_http_endpoints.pair_phone_redeem: POST /api/v1/phone/pair (no prior login needed on /driver; rate-limited; body: {vehicle_id, pair_code, driver_id}; returns driver_phone_token)
optional_server_http_endpoints.phone_telemetry_fallback: POST /api/v1/phone/telemetry (Bearer driver_phone_token; sends phone_gps fallback when hardware GPS indoors)
optional_server_http_endpoints.phone_status_live: GET /api/v1/phone/status?vehicle_id=XE-01 (Bearer driver_phone_token; returns driver_state, calibration, drowsy_escalation, monitoring, esp, gps, pi)
optional_server_http_endpoints.phone_score_and_violations: GET /api/v1/phone/score_summary?vehicle_id=XE-01 (Bearer driver_phone_token; returns current_score /100, score_tier GREEN_GOOD|YELLOW_WARN|RED_LOCKED, trips, violations with can_dispute & dispute_status)
optional_server_http_endpoints.phone_dispute_submit: POST /api/v1/phone/disputes (Bearer driver_phone_token; body: {vehicle_id, violation_event_id, reason_code: FALSE_DETECTION|SENSOR_ERROR|NOT_ME|OTHER, explanation}; 48h window, 1 per violation)
optional_server_http_endpoints.admin_dispute_resolve: POST /api/v1/disputes/{dispute_id}/resolve (Operator/Admin token; Four-Eyes Check; body: {decision: APPROVED|REJECTED, response_note})

web_bluetooth_constraints: Chrome/Edge Android requires HTTPS (use Cloudflare Tunnel or localhost) — plain http://192.168.x.x is blocked by browser security policy.
Safari on iOS does NOT implement Web Bluetooth; iPhone users must use Bluefy browser or a native/Flutter app.
Do NOT remove newline '\n' terminator when writing to NUS RX characteristic.
